name: Kyonan (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kyonan town emblem in yellow: a ring crossed by three horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kyonan, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 October 1975.

features.role: Kyonan town emblem — a ring crossed by three horizontal bars
